title: Interpretation
description: JSON schema for the AI analyst interpretation of one SimilarityResult. Returned by POST /api/interpret.

analog_summary.description: ≤100 words. What this Earth site analogs about the target — which conditions match and why they matter for the mission type.

non_analog_summary.description: ≤100 words. What this site does NOT analog — explicitly names the conditions Earth cannot reproduce (gravity, atmosphere, absolute temperatures, radiation, regolith).

testable_activities.description: Activities that can be tested or trained at this Earth location relevant to the mission type.

highlight.description: One sentence explaining why this characteristic score is notable.

characteristic_highlights.description: Optional: one highlight per selected characteristic. Omit if no highlight is meaningful.

confidence_note.description: Explicit note on data limitations affecting this interpretation. Must reference the confidence level and any proxy or UNVERIFIED data used.

ai_disclosure.const: This interpretation was generated by an AI language model from measured data and scoring results. It has not been independently verified by domain scientists. Treat as a hypothesis, not a finding.
ai_disclosure.description: Standard AI-use disclosure string — must match this exact value.
